prompt_text: Which title company in St. Louis MO is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” title company for every closing, but **Community Title Services** looks like a strong local option based on the information available: it handles residential closings, serves Missouri and nearby states, and reports more than 115 five-star Google reviews. It’s at **2112 Schuetz Rd, St. Louis, MO 63146**; **(314) 695-5223**.

I’d also compare **Investors Title** for its long local track record and broad St. Louis-area coverage, or **Freedom Title** if flexible or mobile closing options matter. Before choosing, ask for a written estimate of title and closing fees, confirm your lender will work with the company, and compare how promptly each responds. You can generally choose the title company yourself, subject to your contract and lender requirements.
